name: @clue-harness/kb-face
description: The Cordis face of the knowledge base (M3b/M4): ctx.kb service, kb_search/kb_propose/kb_cite tools (models may only PROPOSE; citations drive precise attribution), retrieval-first pre-step injection through message rewrite, tools/result file-change tracking, and the turn-stopping evidence gate — failed inspections retrieve precedents by failure signature and inject complaint + precedent as one message, with inspection and injection budgets split.
